text: I see you have no significant past medical history. To narrow down the cause of your weight loss and fatigue, do you have any abdominal pain, changes in bowel habits, or difficulty swallowing?

text: Given your age and symptoms of unexplained weight loss and fatigue with a normal abdominal ultrasound, I need to rule out malignancy or cardiac issues. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray is normal, so we can rule out obvious lung pathology or heart failure. With fatigue and weight loss persisting despite normal abdominal and chest imaging, I need to check for hematologic or metabolic causes. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count
